description: Use when you (an agent) want to sign in to a site or API gated by TOKENLOCK, using a Bitcoin name or token your own wallet holds (for example a name bought with buy_name). Free; nothing is paid or sent. Step 1 of 2: returns challenge_id and the exact `message` to sign. For a TOKENLOCK site, pass its publishable site_key (pk_…, public on its sign-in page) and the site origin; the tokens it accepts come from the site. Without a site_key you can name the assets (or any_name) to get a general pass. Then sign `message` with your wallet (BIP-322 or legacy sign-message) and call finish_token_signin within 10 minutes. Counts as a sign-in on the site's plan only when it passes.

any_name.description: Without site_key: accept any vanity name on Bitcoin.

assets.description: Without site_key: tokens or names that unlock (any one is enough).

origin.description: The gated site's origin, e.g. https://example.com. Required with site_key.

site_key.description: The site's publishable key pk_… (from its sign-in page). Omit for a general pass.

name: start_token_signin
title: Start a token sign-in (gate)
